# Relay pricing

Relay has three plans. Starter costs 29 dollars per seat per month and is limited to three seats. Team costs 49 dollars per seat per month with no seat limit. Enterprise is custom priced and starts at fifty seats.

Single sign-on via SAML is included on the Team plan. Starter does not include single sign-on.

Paying annually takes 20 percent off the monthly price on every plan. Invoices are issued in dollars, euros or pounds.

Every new account gets a 14 day free trial on the Team plan. No credit card is needed to start the trial.
